svg.title: Epidemic gossip propagation across ten nodes
svg.desc: Randomized fanout spreads a rumor quickly at first; duplicate contacts and the final uninformed nodes slow convergence.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: Model assumptions: connected, well-mixed peers; randomized peer selection; no packet loss or node failures. Real clusters converge probabilistically, not at a fixed round.
